question: Under West Virginia's CDL classification system, what defines a CLASS A commercial driver's license?
choice_a: A combination of vehicles with a GCWR of 26,001 pounds or more, provided the GVWR of the unit being towed is 10,001 pounds or greater
choice_b: A single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more
choice_c: A vehicle designed to transport 16 or more passengers, including the driver
choice_d: Any vehicle used to transport hazardous materials requiring placards
explanation: The manual defines CLASS A as a combination of vehicles with a GCWR of 26,001 pounds or more, provided the GVWR of the towed unit is 10,001 pounds or greater.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Chapter III - Commercial Driver's License Types/Classes, p. XVII

question: According to the WV CDL manual, which vehicle description matches a CLASS B license?
choice_a: A combination of vehicles with a GCWR of 26,001 pounds or more, towing a unit with a GVWR of 10,001 pounds or more
choice_b: A single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more, towing a unit with a GVWR less than 10,001 pounds
choice_c: A vehicle under 26,001 pounds GVWR designed to carry 16 or more passengers
choice_d: A non-commercial motor vehicle used for hire
explanation: CLASS B covers single vehicles with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more towing any unit with a GVWR less than 10,001 pounds.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Chapter III - Commercial Driver's License Types/Classes, p. XVII

question: The manual defines a CLASS C CDL as applying to vehicles with a GVWR or GCWR less than 26,001 pounds when which condition applies?
choice_a: The vehicle is towing an additional unit weighing more than 10,000 pounds
choice_b: The vehicle is equipped with air brakes
choice_c: The vehicle is designed to transport 16 or more passengers including the driver, or is used to transport hazardous materials requiring placarding under 49 C.F.R.
choice_d: The vehicle is registered exclusively for interstate commerce
explanation: CLASS C applies to vehicles under 26,001 pounds GVWR/GCWR that are designed to carry 16 or more passengers or that transport placarded hazardous materials.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Chapter III - Commercial Driver's License Types/Classes, p. XVII

question: Per the manual, who is required to obtain a WV CLASS D license?
choice_a: Anyone driving a personal vehicle over 10,000 pounds
choice_c: Farmers exempt under the farm vehicle exemption
choice_d: Persons at least 18 years old with at least one year of licensed driving experience whose primary function or employment is the transportation of persons or property for compensation or wages
explanation: The manual states a CLASS D license is issued to persons at least 18 years old with at least one year of licensed driving experience whose primary function or employment is transporting persons or property for compensation or wages.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Chapter III - Class D License (Non-Commercial Motor Vehicles for Hire), p. XVII

question: What are the minimum age and driving-experience requirements the manual sets for a WV CDL or CLP applicant?
choice_a: At least 18 years old and at least one year of licensed driving experience
choice_b: At least 21 years old and at least two years of licensed driving experience
choice_c: At least 16 years old with no experience requirement
choice_d: At least 25 years old and at least five years of licensed driving experience
explanation: The manual's Age and Fitness Requirements state you must be at least 18 years old and have at least one year of licensed driving experience to qualify for a CDL or CLP.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Age and Fitness Requirements, p. XIII

question: How long may a WV Commercial Learner's Permit (CLP) be issued for, and how many times can it be renewed?
choice_b: Up to 180 days, renewable one time within a two-year period
choice_d: Six months, renewable twice within one year
explanation: The manual states the CLP may not be issued for a period to exceed 180 days, and only one renewal or re-issuance may be granted within a two-year period.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Learner's Permit (CLP), p. XVII

question: Per the manual, how many days must an applicant hold a CLP before becoming eligible to take the CDL road skills test?
choice_d: 60 days
explanation: The manual states applicants must hold a CLP for a minimum of 14 days before they are eligible to take the road skills test.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), First Time CDL Applicants, p. XXI

question: The manual states a CLP holder may only drive a CMV on a highway when accompanied by whom?
choice_d: A driver, age 21 or older, who holds a CDL valid for the type of vehicle being driven, occupying a seat beside the CLP holder
explanation: The manual requires the CLP holder to be accompanied by a driver age 21 or older who holds a CDL valid for the vehicle type, seated beside the CLP holder for purposes of instruction or testing.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Learner's Permit (CLP), p. XVII

question: According to WV's CDL endorsement fee chart, which two endorsements require a TSA fingerprint and background check prior to testing?
choice_a: H (Hazardous Materials) and X (Hazardous Materials and Tank)
choice_d: F (Motorcycle) and N (Tank Vehicles)
explanation: The endorsement fee chart notes that both the H (Hazardous Materials) and X (Hazardous Materials and Tank) endorsements require a TSA fingerprint and background check prior to testing.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: What does the WV CDL 'T' endorsement authorize a driver to pull?
choice_a: Tank vehicles carrying liquid or gaseous cargo
choice_d: A passenger vehicle with a design capacity of 16 or more
explanation: The endorsement table lists 'T' as the Doubles/Triples - Trailers endorsement.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: What does WV restriction code 'E' indicate on a CDL?
choice_a: Restricts the driver to intrastate driving only
choice_b: Restricts the driver to Class B or C buses only
choice_c: Restricts the driver to NO manual transmission equipped CMVs
choice_d: Restricts the driver to NO full air brake equipped CMVs
explanation: The restrictions table defines code 'E' as restricting the driver to no manual transmission equipped CMVs.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: Per the manual's restriction table, when is restriction code 'K' used on a WV CDL?
choice_a: When a driver fails the vehicle inspection portion of the skills test
choice_b: When a driver holds a hazardous materials endorsement
choice_c: When a driver requests a duplicate license
choice_d: When a driver is under age 21 or is required to possess a CDL Intrastate Medical Waiver
explanation: The manual states the 'K' restriction (intrastate driving, WV only) is used when a driver is under age 21 or is required to possess a CDL Intrastate Medical Waiver.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: What does WV restriction code 'L' prohibit a driver from operating?
choice_b: Buses with a GVWR over 26,000 pounds
choice_d: Combination vehicles connected with a fifth wheel
explanation: The restrictions table states code 'L' restricts the driver to vehicles not equipped with air brakes, meaning the driver may not operate air brake equipped CMVs.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: According to the manual's restriction table, what does WV restriction code 'O' prohibit a driver from operating?
choice_c: A CMV tank vehicle with cargo
choice_d: A CMV with a manual transmission
explanation: The restrictions table defines code 'O' as restricting the driver to no tractor-trailer CMVs.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: What does the WV restriction code 'X' mean on a CDL?
choice_a: No passengers in a CMV bus
choice_b: Driver qualified with a medical variance
choice_c: No cargo in a CMV tank vehicle
choice_d: No manual-transmission CMVs
explanation: The restrictions table defines code 'X' as no cargo in a CMV tank vehicle.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Commercial Driver's License Types, Endorsements, and Restrictions, p. XX

question: Per the Knowledge Test section, which endorsements can be added to a Commercial Learner's Permit (CLP) rather than only to a full CDL?
choice_a: Hazardous Materials, Tank Vehicle, and Doubles/Triples
choice_c: Hazardous Materials, Passengers, and School Bus
choice_d: Only Passenger, School Bus, or Tank endorsements
explanation: The manual specifically notes that only Passenger, School Bus, or Tank endorsements can be added to a CLP; all other endorsements can only be added to a full CDL.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Knowledge Test, p. XXIV

question: What minimum score must an applicant achieve to pass the WV CDL knowledge test?
explanation: The manual states the knowledge test must be taken and passed with at least an 80% score.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Knowledge Test, p. XXIV

question: If an applicant fails any portion of the WV CDL knowledge exam, how long must they wait before retesting?
choice_d: There is no mandatory waiting period
explanation: The manual states that if you fail any portion of the knowledge exam, you must wait seven days before you may retest.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Knowledge Test, p. XXIV

question: How many attempts at the knowledge test does an applicant receive per $32.50 fee payment, per the manual?
choice_d: Unlimited attempts within 30 days
explanation: The manual states you may test three times per each $32.50 fee paid, covering the general knowledge, air brakes, and combination tests.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Knowledge Test / Typical DMV Transaction Fees, p. XXI, XXIV

question: What fees does the manual specify for the CDL road skills test and for failing to appear at a scheduled test?
choice_a: $50 for the test, with a $25 no-show fee
choice_b: $150 for the test, with a $75 no-show fee
choice_c: $75 for the test, with a $100 no-show fee
choice_d: $100 for the test, paid to the third-party examiner, with a $50 no-show fee
explanation: The manual states the cost of the skills test is $100, paid to the third-party examiner, and a $50 no-show fee is charged to an applicant who schedules a test and does not appear.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), First Time CDL Applicants / CDL Skills Test, p. XXI, XXIV

question: To apply for or retain a HAZMAT endorsement, the manual directs applicants to contact which organization to pay a fee and begin the TSA fingerprint and background check?
choice_d: The Commercial Driver's License Information System (CDLIS)
explanation: The manual instructs HAZMAT applicants to contact Universal Enrollment Services (UES) to pay the $86.50 fee and begin the fingerprint and background check process.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), ALL Hazardous Materials Endorsement (HAZMAT) Holders and Applicants, p. XXI

question: According to the manual, how many attempts is a HAZMAT endorsement holder given to test and pass the HAZMAT endorsement when renewing a valid, non-expired CDL?
choice_d: Unlimited attempts within 60 days
explanation: The manual states a HAZMAT endorsement holder renewing their CDL will receive three attempts to test and pass the HAZMAT endorsement on a valid, non-expired license.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), ALL Hazardous Materials Endorsement (HAZMAT) Holders and Applicants, p. XXI

question: Under WV's 'Drive for Five' Program, when do driver's licenses (including CDLs) expire, and for how long are they valid?
choice_a: On the anniversary of issuance, valid for four years
choice_b: On January 1st following issuance, valid for three years
choice_c: On the licensee's birthday at an age divisible by five, with the CDL valid for five years instead of four
choice_d: On the licensee's 65th birthday only, valid for life thereafter
explanation: The manual states that under the Drive for Five Program, all driver's licenses including CDLs expire on your birthday at an age divisible by five, and your CDL will be valid for five years instead of four.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Drive for Five Program, p. XI

question: Per the manual's definitions, driving a CMV between two places within West Virginia where the cargo or passengers are part of a trip that began or will end in another state is classified as what kind of commerce?
choice_d: Interstate commerce
explanation: The manual defines interstate commerce to include driving between two places within a state when the cargo or passengers are part of a trip that began or will end in another state or foreign country.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Interstate or Intrastate Commerce, p. XII

question: A CDL holder who operates in interstate commerce but exclusively for excepted activities, such as transporting school children between home and school, self-certifies under which status?
choice_a: Interstate excepted, and is not required to obtain a medical examiner's certificate
choice_b: Interstate non-excepted, requiring a medical examiner's certificate
choice_d: Intrastate excepted
explanation: The manual's self-certification statements describe drivers who engage exclusively in excepted interstate activities, such as transporting school children, as certifying 'interstate excepted' and not needing a medical examiner's certificate.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Self-Certification Statements, p. XIII

question: Per the manual, a bona fide farmer or farm vehicle driver may be exempt from CDL requirements if the vehicle is used within how many miles of a qualifying farm?
choice_d: 250 miles
explanation: The manual lists use of the vehicle within 150 miles of a qualifying farm as one condition for the farm vehicle/driver CDL exemption.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Who is exempt?, p. X

question: Before issuing a CDL or CLP, the manual states the Commissioner must obtain a driving record through which systems?
choice_c: The Commercial Driver's License Information System (CDLIS), the National Driver Register (NDR), and the Problem Driver Pointer System (PDPS)
choice_d: The International Registration Plan (IRP) database
explanation: The manual requires the Commissioner to obtain a driving record through CDLIS, the NDR, and the PDPS, plus from each state or jurisdiction where the person has been licensed, before issuing a CDL or CLP.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Applicant Record Check, p. XI

question: If a WV CDL is more than six months expired, what must the holder do to obtain a valid CDL again, per the manual?
choice_b: Wait an additional 90 days before reapplying
choice_c: Retake only the HAZMAT background check
choice_d: Pass the knowledge and road skills tests for both a CLASS E driver's license and a CDL
explanation: The manual states that if your CDL is more than six months expired, you must pass the knowledge and road skills tests for both a CLASS E driver's license and a CDL before you can obtain a valid CDL.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Expiration of CDL, p. XXIV

question: Per the manual, how long is a driver disqualified from operating a CMV for a first conviction of driving under the influence of alcohol while operating a commercial motor vehicle?
choice_d: For life
explanation: The manual states that for a first conviction of driving a CMV under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, a driver is disqualified for a period of one year.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Disqualification/Cancellation of a CDL, p. XXIX

question: According to the manual, at what blood alcohol concentration is it illegal to operate a CMV in West Virginia?
choice_d: .10% or more
explanation: The manual states it is illegal to operate a CMV if your blood alcohol concentration is .04% or more.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Section 1.3.2 - Alcohol, Leaving the Scene of an Accident, and Commission of a Felony, p. 1-7

question: Per the manual, how long is a CDL disqualified for two serious traffic violations committed within a three-year period while operating a CMV?
choice_d: At least 120 days
explanation: The manual states you will lose your CDL for at least 60 days if you have committed two serious traffic violations within a three-year period involving a CMV.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Section 1.3.3 - Serious Traffic Violations, p. 1-8

question: Per the manual's ELDT section, which applicants are required to complete Entry Level Driver Training before testing?
choice_a: All CDL holders regardless of issuance date
choice_c: Drivers issued a Class A or B CDL before February 7, 2022
choice_d: First-time applicants seeking a Class A or B CDL for the first time, upgrading a Class B to a Class A, or obtaining a P, S, or H endorsement for the first time
explanation: The manual states ELDT is required to obtain a Class A or B CDL for the first time, to upgrade an existing Class B CDL to a Class A, or to obtain a school bus, passenger, or hazardous materials endorsement for the first time.
source_note: West Virginia CDL Manual (WV DMV, Rev. 08/2023), Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT), p. XXXIX
